title: Writing Automated Tests
summary: How Rust tests work: test functions and assertion macros, testing panics and returning Result, controlling how cargo test runs, and organizing unit tests, integration tests and doc tests.
goals: Write test functions with assert!, assert_eq!, assert_ne! and custom failure messages
Test for panics with should_panic and write tests that return Result
Control cargo test with filters, ignored tests, threads and output capture
Organize unit tests in modules, integration tests in tests/, and examples as doc tests
